requirements: Fresh actual candidates and every necessary supplied frozen original reference must be viewed. Model/state/metadata/mechanical/old review results cannot give current visual, glyph, weight or line-style PASS.

Match an explicitly declared exact reference SHA only to the same-module owner reference member. Supplements without independent PNG and stretch profiles are related-contract comparisons with native dimensions preserved; do not invent exact state or resize an original.

Use actual route, modal, context and device orientation. Base 500 labels and selected 700 states come from this case actual scope; no prior PASS or precise typeface/numeric-weight guess substitutes for actual glyph observation.

Retain complete case JSON/PNG/state/metadata/actions/log and necessary source/input/HTTP/provider/storage/DB/oracle pointers. Preserve every raw failed check and prerequisite flag; a failed recipe or wrong expected state is not automatically a product defect.

Fixture/cache/observer prerequisites remain contextual and add no primary manual count or automatic picture opening. Open an own closed Reader dependency only when this module actually contains the specific overlay and closed prerequisite, and include it in the image budget.

Root closed Reader is artwork only: no app footer/ribbon/page/status/debug decoration or invisible footer-cycle claim. Source printed borders/captions need owner source-art provenance; screenshots cannot qualify hidden input, hardware, runtime, performance or lease.

Real raw/full titles, compact text and native overflow are independent. Truthful unavailable/fixed-on controls and content-driven sheet origins retain their bounded accepted scope. Unsupported, aborted or unexecuted operations must not receive operation PASS.

Use only static local frozen evidence and actual original viewing. No SSH, App, tests, builds, validators, probes, hashes, image processing, PIL, crop, resize, child spawning or queue continuation. No source/harness/plan/original/old report/ledger/registry edits.

Necessary unreadable glyphs/extents remain reading_pending for a coordinator-registered sole-producer original-scale crop. At most four manual cases, four reference pairs and eight necessary original opens; only the assigned new compact English report is writable.

Keep flat freeze/evidence_binding/modules once and exact artifact/reference/support SHA with actual-view records and concrete bounded findings. Root full R1 is already nonclean; continue every current opinion without full/clean/R2 credit.
